meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Rechecked role-scoped manifest generator after #265: contract docs list actual private Markdown paths/content hashes without copying prompt bodies; guardrail and JSON session semantics remain unchanged. Current acceptance belongs in GitHub #251.

auth.review_note: Compared actual AuthController password, registration and OAuth redirects and MySQL writes against auth/OAuth guides; corrected users.json and customer dashboard wording without changing credentials or behavior.

commerce.review_note: Baseline mapped existing catalogue/order/tax sources to their durable module contracts. No commerce implementation or live transaction is changed; the review does not certify tax filing or untested payment receipt.

content.review_note: Reviewed original SeoService and BlogController override paths plus resolved local/persistent image contracts. Canonical/OG/organization defaults now use configured APP_URL, valid explicit overrides remain, bad URL schemes/local missing images fall back safely, and product schema follows in_stock/active and resolved price. Six regressions cover host/request forms, overrides/noindex, real image paths, stock/slug encoding and inline JSON-LD safety.

foundation.review_note: Compared deployment instructions with actual MailQueueService enqueue/deliverNow, bounded cli/bapXphp mail:process and route registry. Removed deleted worker cron and nonexistent generic Audit Log menu; documented pending-only processing and SMTP-vs-inbox evidence. No runtime code/data change. Release verification now matches owner-authorized Playwright and Ready PR workflow.

interface.review_note: Compared rendered public head with SeoService output and verified desktop/mobile browser metadata. Removed the layout Host-header bypass and manual organization JSON interpolation, preserving page bodies, forms, customer Help links and private noindex. Five browser cases verify actual public metadata, product prices/current stock and image responses without business mutations.

mail.review_note: Baseline checked against native SMTP claim/acceptance boundaries and current mail guide; SMTP acceptance is explicitly not inbox receipt. No mail implementation changed in this issue.

media.review_note: Media deletion and storage behavior are unchanged. Shared architecture text now accurately states configured-origin metadata; SeoService only checks approved local/persistent image paths and does not fetch external URLs or mutate media. Rechecked the existing media verification reference against unchanged media services.

operator-help.review_note: Compared catalogue guide stock/visibility and metadata wording with ProductService, checkout eligibility and updated SeoService. Added SeoService as an explicit catalogue source dependency; guides explain configured domain and cache/ranking limits without promising inventory quantity or search performance. Help routes/auth/text rendering remain unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed DocumentationReview snapshots/digest safety, exact source ownership rules and fixed Help metadata. Added explicit dependency union with deduplication and a failing-then-passing cross-area source-change regression; source hashes require human rationale, while issues/plans/release evidence stay in GitHub and generated indexes remain discovery only.
